obs_datum.source: tool response field coops_datum (CO-OPS request datum)

texts: datum_note: STOFS datum: LMSL (file metadata: zeta:standard_name=sea_surface_height_above_msl) | CO-OPS datum: MSL. No vertical transformation is applied. Matching labels do not guarantee identical realizations or epochs, so a mean offset (bias) alone does not show whether its cause is the reference or the model. The CO-OPS MSL datum is defined on a tidal-datum epoch (1983–2001 at most stations); recent mean sea level may differ from it, so a mean bias includes that difference unless the model carries present-day mean level. The station's epoch is not checked here.
